name: RACE-Track | MRTrix3 Anatomical Informed Tractography
summary: Generates an ensemble whole-brain tractogram with MRtrix3 anatomically constrained tractography (ACT) from preprocessed single- or multi-shell DWI and a T1w image, combining CSD and tensor algorithms across lmax and curvature values.
description: Builds a brain mask with FSL bet, a five-tissue-type image with 5ttgen fsl, fits the tensor (and kurtosis for multi-shell) and CSD or multi-shell multi-tissue CSD at each lmax, and runs tckgen with the selected algorithms (iFOD2, iFOD1, SD_STREAM, FACT, Tensor_Det, Tensor_Prob) seeded at the grey-white matter interface for every lmax and curvature; all streamlines are merged into one track.tck (RACE-Track). Use it to produce a whole-brain tractogram for tract segmentation or connectomics. Needs a preprocessed DWI and a T1w image aligned to it. Expect long runtimes for many parameter combinations.

inputs.description: Preprocessed DWI with bvecs and bvals.
inputs.requirements: Must contain b=0 volumes; single- or multi-shell.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image aligned to the DWI, used by 5ttgen fsl to build the five-tissue-type image for ACT.
inputs.requirements: If already skull-stripped, set premask to true.

outputs.description: Ensemble tractogram (track.tck) merging the streamlines from every requested algorithm, lmax and curvature.
Tensor-model outputs (fa, md, ad, rd, cl, cp, cs, tensor and kurtosis files). Note: in this branch the code copies fa.nii.gz into every file of this folder, so only fa is correct.
CSD fibre orientation distributions per lmax (lmaxN.nii.gz), normalised when norm is true.

parameters.description:
If multi-shell data is passed, this selects the shell that will be extracted and have a tensor fit performed

If single-shell data is passed, this is ignored
perform log-domain normalization of CSD data before tracking (multi-shell data only)
the minimum length a streamline may be
the maximum length a streamline may be
The lmax(s) or maximum value to fit and create tractography data. If not provided,  the App will find the maximum possible lmax within the data and use that.
perform ensemble tracking on every lmax up to the maximum value passed
the maximum curvature angle streamline can take during tracking
the number of streamlines to produce per parameter combination
Number of peak directions extracted from each FOD for FACT tracking.
Number of FACT streamlines to generate per lmax.
If the input anatomical T1s have already been skull stripped, check this to prevent 5ttgen from cutting off a portion of the brain.  (This sets -premasked option for 5ttgens)

failure_modes.message: iFOD2 Probabilistic tracking timed out with settings
failure_modes.cause: tckgen exceeded the 24000 s timeout without reaching the requested count.
failure_modes.fix: Lower num_fibers or the number of lmax/curvature combinations.

failure_modes.cause: The merged tractogram has fewer streamlines than requested.
failure_modes.fix: Check the log for the failing tckgen run and adjust the tracking parameters.
